sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
In Ball Crazy 3D, players take on the role of a ball that needs to navigate through a challenging 3D environment. The game is divided into levels, each with its own unique layout, obstacles, and power-ups. The ball can be controlled using mouse, keyboard, or touch controls, making it accessible to players of all ages and skill levels.

The game's core mechanics are simple yet challenging, requiring players to react quickly to obstacles, power-ups, and other balls that may be on the screen. Players can use a variety of special powers and boosts to overcome obstacles, such as speed boosts, gravity changes, and shields. These powers can be collected by colliding with power-up balls or by completing specific objectives within a level.

As players progress through the game, the levels become increasingly challenging, with new obstacles, power-ups, and game-changing events introduced. Players must use their reflexes, pattern recognition, and quick decision-making skills to overcome these challenges and achieve high scores.
